\[ P(\text{Spam} | \text{Flagged}) = \frac{P(\text{Flagged} | \text{Spam}) \cdot P(\text{Spam})}{P(\text{Flagged})} \]

Where:

- \( P(\text{Spam}) = 0.20 \)
- \( P(\text{Flagged}) = \frac{180 + 40}{1000} = 0.22 \)

\[ P(\text{Spam} | \text{Flagged}) = \frac{0.90 \cdot 0.20}{0.22} \approx 0.8182 \]
